description: Create a draft push import and return its warnings; nothing is read until start_push_import. Requirements by source: onesignal needs apiKey (App API key) and onesignalAppId; braze needs apiKey (REST key with users.export.segment), brazeRestEndpoint and brazeSegmentId; customer_io needs apiKey (App API key), customerIoSegmentId and optionally customerIoRegion; csv takes the file as csv (token and platform columns, plus external_id or email; at most 5 MB, send more with add_push_import_rows and set csvParts to the total part count so a partial upload can never start). Opted-in devices are linked to contacts by external ID or email (unmatched devices get a new contact, quietly: no lists, no sequences; push-only with no email or phone when the device has only an external ID); opted-out devices are kept as unsubscribed.

apiKey.description: Source API key (not for csv). Stored encrypted and never returned; deleted once devices are read or the import is canceled (a failed import keeps it for resume).

appIds.description: Only import devices of these source apps (Braze app name, Customer.io app_identifier, CSV app_id).

brazeRestEndpoint.description: Braze REST endpoint such as rest.iad-01.braze.com. Required for braze.

brazeSegmentId.description: API identifier of a Braze segment with the users to import. Required for braze.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

csv.description: csv source only: the CSV text (or its first part).

csvParts.description: csv source only: how many parts you will send, including this first one. When set, start_push_import is refused until every part has been added, so an interrupted upload is never imported partially. Recommended whenever you send more than one part.

customerIoSegmentId.description: ID of a Customer.io segment with the people to import. Required for customer_io.

importAttributes.description: Copy source tags/attributes onto contacts, only for keys a contact lacks (default true).

onesignalAppId.description: OneSignal App ID (UUID). Required for onesignal.

platforms.description: Platforms to import (default both). Web push cannot be imported: browsers tie those subscriptions to the previous provider's VAPID keys.

name: create_push_import

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `create_push_import` MCP tool.

import.description: The push import (draft, with warnings) record returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
